decisions.reason: The new approval-duration threshold does not change the Google Drive packaging, access, or submission-channel requirements.
The impact is already fully represented by the existing message-280 MODIFY setting approval_minimum_duration_seconds to 45.
Only client-approved clips remain eligible for publication; the new approval threshold does not change the publishing destination, format, or eligibility rule.
The source explicitly applies to the next batch and does not alter the completed initial three-clip trial.
The approval-duration and complete-lesson statement does not change any background-music requirement.
The source reiterates the already-current requirement that clips provide complete lessons or full value; it establishes no new or changed top-level attribute.
Requiring a complete lesson and a 45-second approval minimum does not change the permitted source material or source-selection rules.
The source changes prepublication approval criteria, not the cadence or time window for posting approved clips.
The source concerns a later next batch and does not modify the earlier extended-trial clip count, source content, or acceptance standard.
The source does not change how B-roll must be selected or integrated.
The source explicitly addresses the next batch and does not alter the five-clip first-live deliverable.
The approval threshold does not add, remove, or otherwise change any target channel.
